question: Simplify: (sqrt{98} + sqrt{200} - 2sqrt{8})²
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplify the surds directly by extracting perfect square factors:

⇒ (√98 + √200 − 2√8)²

⇒ (7√2 + 10√2 − 4√2)²

⇒ (13√2)²

⇒ 169 × 2 = 338

**∴ The correct answer is 338.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(√98 + √200 − 2√8)²

**Calculations:**

Break down each radical into its simplest form by factoring out perfect squares:

⇒ √98 = √(49 × 2) = 7√2

⇒ √200 = √(100 × 2) = 10√2

⇒ 2√8 = 2 × √(4 × 2) = 2 × 2√2 = 4√2

Substitute the simplified values back into the given expression:

⇒ (7√2 + 10√2 − 4√2)²

Combine the like terms:

⇒ (17√2 − 4√2)²

⇒ (13√2)²

Square the combined term:

⇒ 13² × (√2)²

⇒ 169 × 2 = 338

**∴ The correct answer is 338.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simplification of Surds

A surd is simplified by identifying and extracting the largest perfect square factor from under the root: √(a² × b) = a√b.

Addition and Subtraction of Surds

Only like surds (surds having the exact same irrational part) can be added or subtracted directly: a√x + b√x = (a + b)√x.

BODMAS Rule

Always simplify the expressions inside the Brackets first before applying higher order operations like exponentiation (Order).
